newsitem.title: GERMANY: German builders group sees fall in investment.
newsitem.headline: German builders group sees fall in investment.

text.p: Germany's ZDB building employers federation said on Monday it expected investment in the construction sector to fall by 2.5 percent this year.
ZDB president Fritz Eichbauer, in the text of a speech he was due to give, said investment would fall by two percent in western Germany and four percent in the former communist east.
Investment in housing will fall by 2.5 percent, in commercial construction by two percent and in the public sector by three percent, Eichbauer said.

German construction activity plunged in January by 25 percent against the previous month due to bad weather, changes to winter payments for idle building workers and tax revisions which encouraged projects to be brought forward to 1996.
In January, the BI builders federation said it expected building investment to fall by a real 1.4 percent this year in western Germany and by five percent in the east.
In 1996, investment in the sector fell by three percent in the west and by 1.7 percent in the east, the BI said.
